title: Finite affine stage refinement of an etale cover with representing maps
statement: Let X be a scheme, J a small cofiltered category, D:J→X_et an affine open diagram, and c its limiting underlying scheme cone with structural map p:c.pt→X satisfying c.π_j;D(j).hom=p [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-open-immersion]. Let I index an arbitrary etale cover z_i:Z_i→(c.pt,id), let W_i be etale X-objects, and let a_i:Z_i→p*W_i be representing arrows [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then there exist a stage j, a finite possibly empty set B, a selection r:B→I, affine etale X-objects V_b, arrows v_b:V_b→D(j) covering D(j), arrows w_b:V_b→W_{r(b)}, and arrows e_b:p*V_b→Z_{r(b)}, such that the family e_b;z_{r(b)} covers the terminal etale object of c.pt and p*(w_b)=e_b;a_{r(b)}. Refinement and repetition of indices are permitted. No sheaf or section occurs in this geometric assertion.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.2, qcqs affine object and arrow descent and finite covering descent; Tag 03Q6 proof steps (1)-(3); Tag 01ZC(3) for locally finitely presented target factorization

proof.text: Apply Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit to the underlying affine scheme diagram. Its limit is quasi-compact. Scheme.exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology produces Fin n-indexed affine sources T_q, terminal arrows t_q in the original covering sieve and a jointly surjective family. Membership in Sieve.ofArrows factors t_q=f_q;z_{r(q)}. Compose f_q with a_{r(q)} to retain representing arrows.

Apply IsFiltered.exists_directed to J opposite, and use F.leftOp.Initial and Initial.isLimitWhiskerEquiv to reindex the diagram without changing its cone vertex. The affine stages supply compactness, quasi-separatedness and affine transition maps. Choose one directed stage, its full affine terminal etale object and the pullbacks of W_{r(q)} to that stage. PullbackComp and preservation of terminal objects transport t_q and f_q;a_{r(q)} into the input of etale_finiteCoverFactorizationDescent. Obtain a later stage, affine source models, both descended arrow families under common source isomorphisms, and a stage covering.

Identify the stage pullback of the fixed terminal object with the later terminal object. Uniqueness of terminal arrows identifies each descended covering arrow with its model structure map, so the cover transfers by joint surjectivity. Localize source models along the stage open immersion into X, and compose representing arrows with pullback projections. Since that immersion is mono and p factors through it, the X-pullback and the stage pullback are isomorphic: explicitly lift the two projections in both directions and check inverse identities by pullback hom_ext. Compose this isomorphism with the common source comparison from finite-cover descent. The fst projection of the representing equation follows from the descended equation and the projection identities for pullbackComp; the snd projection is the structural equation. Pullback hom_ext proves the representing equation.

Compose each limit-source comparison with f_q to obtain e_q. Transfer the finite limit covering through the source isomorphisms: a point y of T_q lifts via the inverse source comparison, and t_q=f_q;z_{r(q)} gives its image. Reindex Fin n by ULift to put the finite index type in the specified universe; joint surjectivity is unchanged. Associativity gives p*(w_q)=e_q;a_{r(q)}. This proof also works for n=0, without a nonempty-cover assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem affineOpen_representing_cover_descent
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J]
    (D : J ⥤ X.Etale)
    [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom]
    (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X))
    (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p)
    (hc : IsLimit c)
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (Z : I → c.pt.Etale)
    (z : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))
    (W : I → X.Etale) (a : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ p.Etale.obj (W i))
    (hz : Sieve.ofArrows Z z ∈
      c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))) :
    ∃ (j : J) (B : Type (u + 1)) (_ : Finite B) (r : B → I)
      (V : B → X.Etale) (v : ∀ b, V b ⟶ D.obj j)
      (w : ∀ b, V b ⟶ W (r b)) (e : ∀ b, p.Etale.obj (V b) ⟶ Z (r b)),
      (∀ b, IsAffine (V b).left) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows V v ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology (D.obj j) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun b ↦ p.Etale.obj (V b)) (fun b ↦ e b ≫ z (r b)) ∈
        c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)) ∧
      ∀ b, p.Etale.map (w b) = e b ≫ a (r b)
